title: A — #7 one page-break rule
paragraphs: Pages used to be split by three separate copies of the same rule: the live editor, the parked arithmetic engine, and the snapshot review pane. One of them once missed a fix and put the review pane two pages out. This PR folds all three into one shared module.
If this lane looks identical to main, that is the point. Nothing should move.
checks: Open a real multi-page document. Page breaks land on the same lines as production at zoom 1.
Ctrl/⌘+wheel over the page to zoom 1.2. No line is cut in half; breaks may move by a paragraph.
Print preview: same breaks as zoom 1.
Open ◈ → a snapshot. The review pane's page count matches the editor.
